summary: FRONTEND-ONLY mock-driven /documents flow for 'My Documents & In-App Document Signing Prototype' — 12/12 scenarios PASS. Tested on web preview (https://wide-doc-signing.preview.emergentagent.com/documents) via mobile viewport (414x896) with Playwright. Yellow 'Demo signing — not a live signed document' banner is visible on list, review, status screens as required. (S1) Tapping 'Quote — Electricity renewal options' (doc_q_01) routes to /documents/doc_q_01/view; shows 'Page 1 of 2' + 'Page 2 of 2', a 'View only' badge, note 'This is a view-only quote. No signature is required.', and NO sign-submit / NO declaration (both counts=0) — no 'not found' error. (S2) 'Supplier Contract — EDF (cancelled)' routes to /status and shows 'This request is cancelled' + 'Back to My Documents' button (status-back2); no signing. (S2b) 'LOA — Broadband (demo: cancelled while open)' opens review, all 4 LOA fields completed (name/title/email prefilled correctly, signature drawn via mouse pan on signature-pad + sig-apply), declaration ticked, sign-submit tapped → mock rejects with 'cancelled' → full-screen 'Signing unavailable' with terminal-back visible, message mentions cancelled. (S3) 'Supplier Contract — British Gas (3-year)' review shows Page 1/2/3 of 3, progress correctly tracks '5 of 5 fields completed' (s_ack=acknowledgement on p1, s_name/s_initials/s_sign1/s_sign2 on p3); sign-submit is DISABLED (aria-disabled=true) both before fields complete AND before declaration is ticked. After complete + declaration + submit → processing → ~4s later → 'Document signed successfully' with completed-back + Simulated demo-fixture tag. (S4) 'LOA — Gas (demo: processing fails)' submits, status flips to needs_attention after ~2.5s with heading 'We need a moment to finish' and reassuring copy 'you don't need to sign again'. Tapping retry-processing finishes WITHOUT asking to re-sign and lands on completed 'Document signed successfully'. (S4b) 'LOA — EV charging (demo: lost response)' first tap of sign-submit returns an inline red error banner (connection/already-received wording) and the button label flips to 'Try again'. Rapid double-tap during submission is safely blocked (submitting flag + disabled). Second tap succeeds and routes to status → completed. (S5) 'LOA — Telecoms' (Expired badge) routes to status with 'This request is expired' + Back button. (S5b) 'LOA — Waste (demo: expires while open)' submits → mock rejects with 'expired' → full-screen 'Signing unavailable' with terminal-back + 'expired' wording. (S6) 'LOA — Electricity (demo: updated version)' submits → 'Signing unavailable' mentioning document was updated / reopen latest. (S7) 'Supplier Contract — (demo: not your document)' review screen correctly shows load error 'Couldn't open document' + 'You are not authorised to view this document…' + review-retry button; no crash. (S8) First row 'LOA — Electricity' happy path: 4 fields (f_name/f_title/f_email/f_sign) progress tracks '4 of 4 fields completed' (f_date is readOnly and correctly excluded from user-field count), declaration ticked, submit → processing → 'Document signed successfully' + 'Simulated — demo fixture' tag visible + 5 action rows (view-signed/download-signed/view-audit/download-audit/download-combined) + completed-back. Tapping view-audit opens an audit modal containing 'Price Buddy Signing Audit Record (DEMO FIXTURE)' with reference/version/business/intended signer/events; audit-close dismisses it. (S9) filter-needs_signature shows awaiting rows and HIDES completed+view-only (verified doc_loa_01 visible, doc_loa_done hidden, doc_q_01 hidden); filter-completed shows only completed (doc_loa_done visible, doc_loa_01 hidden). FIRST-OPEN tracking is purely internal — opening a review screen never errors, and the unauthorized (S7) failed-load path still renders a graceful error screen rather than crashing or firstOpen'ing. All 12 doc rows render with correct testIDs (doc-<id>), demo banner persists, no red-screen, no React Native component errors. Non-blocking warnings only: 'shadow*' style props deprecated, 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated, '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web' — all pre-existing RN Web/Expo platform notices unrelated to this prototype.
critical_code_review_comments: mock-adapter.ts correctly implements idempotent submit — same idempotencyKey on retry does NOT create a second submission (verified in S4b: lost_response stores submission server-side BEFORE throwing network error, so the retry hits the existing-submission branch and returns processing without re-signing). This matches real-world idempotency semantics.

review.tsx handles the three terminal submit codes (cancelled/expired/superseded) by setting a terminal state that renders a full-screen 'Signing unavailable' message with terminal-back — generic network errors show as inline red banner with the submit button relabelled to 'Try again'. Clean separation.

status.tsx uses bounded exponential backoff for status polling (BACKOFF = [1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000] ms). Good — prevents a tight poll loop. The polling attempt counter is also correctly reset to 0 after a retryProcessing success.

review.tsx 'needsUser' filter correctly excludes readOnly + date_signed fields from the required-user-fields count. This is why LOA shows 4 of 4 (not 5 of 5) despite the fixture defining 5 fields including f_date. Verified in S8.

The 'first-opened' side effect in review.tsx (useEffect at line 60) correctly gates on `req && !terminal && !loadError && !firstOpenDone.current` — so an unauthorized load (S7) does NOT record a false first-open. Good defensive design.

SignaturePad.tsx uses PanResponder which translates to pointer events on react-native-web. Mouse drag inside the SVG canvas successfully produced an SVG path and the sig-apply button was correctly disabled when empty and enabled after a stroke. Works on web preview without a native build.

Non-blocking: multiple consumers of 'shadow*' style props and the 'props.pointerEvents' prop generate RN Web deprecation warnings. These are from shared theme/components elsewhere in the codebase, not from the documents prototype itself. Housekeeping, not urgent.
seed_data_creation: None — all data served by src/features/documents/mock-adapter.ts + fixtures.ts in-memory. State resets on page reload (which is also used to reset between scenarios in the test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: URL: https://wide-doc-signing.preview.emergentagent.com/documents (no auth required). Mobile viewport 414x896 recommended. Row testIDs: doc-<id> (e.g. doc-doc_loa_01, doc-doc_q_01, doc-doc_loa_fail, etc.). Review screen testIDs: field-<fieldId>, field-input, field-save, ack-confirm, declaration, sign-submit, terminal-back, review-retry, zoom-in/zoom-out, next-field. Signature pad: signature-pad, sig-apply, sig-clear, sig-cancel — to produce a non-empty signature, use page.mouse.down() → multiple mouse.move() → mouse.up() INSIDE the svg bounding_box of the signature-pad (NOT clicking buttons — must actually drag). Status screen testIDs: status-back, status-back2, status-retry, retry-processing, attn-back, view-audit, audit-close, completed-back, view-signed, download-signed, download-audit, download-combined. Filters: filter-all / filter-needs_signature / filter-completed. Mock timing: happy-path submit→processing→completed takes ~4700ms (700ms submit + 4000ms processing); fail_then_recover flips to needs_attention after ~2500ms. The lost_response scenario records the submission server-side on the FIRST attempt and throws network error; the SECOND attempt (same idempotency key) returns processing — this is intentional. The service.isMock flag is auto-detected by service.ts; demo banner visibility proves mock mode. If a test needs a fresh state (e.g. for S4b where submissions are cached in memory), reload the /documents page — the submissions Map resets with the module.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all 12 requested scenarios pass end-to-end with no bugs found. Prototype is well-structured: idempotent submit, bounded polling, terminal-code branching, declaration gating, readOnly field exclusion from progress, graceful unauthorized/not-found error UI, and a dismissible demo audit modal.
